summary: Onboarding Engine activity bridge persistence (Issue #15 Milestone 4): a read-only comparison of the cutoff position with actual Trusted financial activity. Creates append-only onboarding_bridge_items (one classified event per row: ALREADY_IN_SOURCE / LEGITIMATE_SUBSEQUENT / AMBIGUOUS / OUT_OF_SCOPE, method, confidence, evidence, structural issues, bridge sha256, Trusted activity fingerprint; CHECK never ALREADY_IN_SOURCE on an amount-only method) and onboarding_bridge_records (UNIQUE per run, table and record: a record cannot be classified twice). Adds onboarding_record_bridge (result + items + records in one transaction; stage activity_bridge only; must name the current snapshot result; identity checked) and onboarding_bridge_view. Replaces onboarding_record_completion (as 483, plus bridge results only with their items). Nothing posts or changes any Trusted record. Service_role only. No rows change.

preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('onboarding_record_snapshot','onboarding_snapshot_view')

expected_changes: Creates onboarding_bridge_items and onboarding_bridge_records (append-only; CHECKs; UNIQUE(completion, item_no), UNIQUE(completion, event_key), UNIQUE(completion, record_table, record_id); FK records -> items; indexes; SELECT/INSERT grants).
Creates functions onboarding_record_bridge and onboarding_bridge_view (EXECUTE to service_role only).
Replaces onboarding_record_completion (activity-bridge results only via onboarding_record_bridge).
